description:
**File**: `src/favicon_cache.cr:30`

**Severity**: P3 (perf)

```crystal
@@access_order.delete(key)        # O(n) Array delete
@@access_order << key
```

`Array#delete` is O(n) — it walks the array to find the key. With
`MAX_ENTRIES = 200`, every cache hit and every cache miss walks up
to 200 elements. Under high traffic this is 200 × O(n) per access.

The cap is small (200) so the absolute cost is bounded, but a
doubly-linked list or a "move-to-back" pointer trick would be
asymptotically O(1).

**Fix sketch**:
1. Use a doubly-linked list of keys, OR
2. Use a Set(String) for membership + Array for ordering
   (still O(n) on `index`), OR
3. Accept the O(n) cost since MAX_ENTRIES is small and document
   the trade-off

**Related**: `quickhea-gz7.7` (Improve valid_image_data? with
magic byte validation) is a different ticket but covers
favicon-cache-related perf. Comment on that ticket to cross-link.

Found during code review 2026-06-18, see
`planning/code-review-2026-06-18.md` §4.3.
title: FaviconCache LRU is O(n) Array delete
